rationale: At each matched interpolation fraction C2 has lower energy AND smaller gradient components; C2 RMS gradients .01994,.03164,.03819 vs C1 .03217,.05913,.07458. Thus lower unrelaxed strain is supported by gradients, not just maximum energy.
C2 three point compute costs 21–35s vs C1 28–157s do not prove later NEB cost, but give no measured computational advantage for C1.

Both channels require C-C/O-O cleavage and H transfer. Prior C2 local r2SCAN saddle searches failed to finish that coupled topology; they do not establish that the C2 mapped endpoints are invalid. New endpoint-to-endpoint NEB at the frozen PBE level replaces that failed local-seed strategy.
No true barrier or channel competitiveness is inferred from these unrelaxed screens. C2 remains provisional pending actual endpoint stability and mapped graph checks.
